import http.client, json, os, signal, subprocess, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
data = Path(tmp.name) / 'nested' / 'store.json'

def start():
    p = subprocess.Popen(['python3', str(root/'server.py'), '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '0', '--data', str(data)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    line = p.stdout.readline().strip()
    assert line.startswith('LISTENING '), (line, p.stderr.read())
    return p, int(line.split()[1])

def req(port, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
    c = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', port, timeout=3)
    raw = None if body is None else (body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode())
    h = {} if headers is None else dict(headers)
    if raw is not None and 'Content-Type' not in h: h['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
    c.request(method, path, body=raw, headers=h)
    r = c.getresponse(); payload = r.read(); out = (r.status, dict(r.getheaders()), payload)
    c.close(); return out

def obj(result): return json.loads(result[2])

p, port = start()
try:
    r=req(port,'GET','/health'); assert r[0]==200 and obj(r)=={'status':'ok'} and r[1]['Content-Type']=='application/json'
    assert req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/missing')[0]==404
    r=req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/hello%20world',{'value':{'x':[1,True,None]}}); assert r[0]==201
    r=req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/hello%20world'); assert r[0]==200 and obj(r)=={'key':'hello world','value':{'x':[1,True,None]}}
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/hello%20world',{'value':'new'})[0]==200
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/z',{'value':3})[0]==201
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/a',{'value':1})[0]==201
    assert obj(req(port,'GET','/v1/keys'))=={'keys':['a','hello world','z']}
    assert req(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/z')[0]==204
    assert req(port,'DELETE','/v1/kv/z')[0]==404
    assert req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/short',{'value':'gone','ttl_seconds':0.15})[0]==201
    time.sleep(.25)
    assert req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/short')[0]==404 and 'short' not in obj(req(port,'GET','/v1/keys'))['keys']
    bad=[('PUT','/v1/kv/x',b'{'),('PUT','/v1/kv/x',[]),('PUT','/v1/kv/x',{}),('PUT','/v1/kv/x',{'value':1,'ttl_seconds':0}),('PUT','/v1/kv/x',{'value':1,'ttl_seconds':True}),('PUT','/v1/kv/',{'value':1}),('PUT','/v1/kv/a%2Fb',{'value':1}),('GET','/unknown',None),('POST','/health',None)]
    for method,path,body in bad:
        r=req(port,method,path,body); assert 400 <= r[0] < 500 and r[1].get('Content-Type')=='application/json', (method,path,r)
    huge=b'x'*(1024*1024+1); r=req(port,'PUT','/v1/kv/big',huge); assert r[0]==413, r
finally:
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); p.wait(timeout=5)
    assert p.returncode==0, (p.returncode,p.stderr.read())

p, port = start()
try:
    assert obj(req(port,'GET','/v1/kv/hello%20world'))=={'key':'hello world','value':'new'}
    assert obj(req(port,'GET','/v1/keys'))=={'keys':['a','hello world']}
finally:
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); p.wait(timeout=5)
    assert p.returncode==0

saved=json.loads(data.read_text())
assert set(saved['entries'])=={'a','hello world'}
print('integration tests passed')
